instruction: Search for "office handshake" on Tenor GIFs, and from the results, take the first one — download it and save the file to "$HOME/Desktop/gifgrep_download_2_3.gif".
reference_command:
first_url=$(gifgrep "office handshake" --source tenor --format url | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$first_url" ]; then
  echo "No GIF URL found for query: office handshake"
  exit 1
fi
curl -L "$first_url" -o "$HOME/Desktop/gifgrep_download_2_3.gif"
